# HealthyPlace

> > HealthyPlace is a comprehensive mental health information and support platform offering evidence-based resources, screening tools, and personal stories for managing bipolar disorder, depression, anxiety, eating disorders, and schizophrenia.

HealthyPlace provides peer support forums, expert-authored blogs, clinical screening assessments, and treatment guides across multiple mental health conditions. The site features contributions from mental health professionals and lived-experience advocates, making it a trusted resource for patients, families, and caregivers seeking mental health education and support strategies.

## Key Topics

- bipolar disorder
- depression treatment
- anxiety disorders
- mental health resources
- teen mental health
- schizophrenia
- eating disorders
- genetic factors in mental illness
- medication and treatment guidelines
- family support strategies
- suicide prevention
- cognitive behavioral therapy
- mental health screening
- emotional wellness
- mental illness stigma

## Screening & Assessment Tools

- [Bipolar Screening Test](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/bipolar-symptoms/bipolar-screening-test): Interactive bipolar disorder screening tool for self-assessment of mania and depression symptoms.

## Bipolar Disorder Resources

- [Brain Damage From Bipolar Disorder](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/articles/brain-damage-from-bipolar-disorder): Research article on cognitive impairment and neuropsychological effects of bipolar disorder episodes.
- [UCLA-led Study Challenges Bipolar Depression Treatment Guidelines](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/articles/challenges-bipolar-depression-treatment-guidelines): Research article on bipolar depression treatment guidelines and antidepressant relapse prevention.
- [Genetics of Bipolar Disorder](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/articles/genetics-of-bipolar-disorder): Research article on genetic inheritance and hereditary factors in bipolar disorder development.
- [The Manic Panic Connection](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/articles/manic-panic-connection): Research on genetic connection between bipolar disorder and panic disorder comorbidity.
- [Bipolar Symptoms in Children Mimic Other Psychiatric Disorders](https://www.healthyplace.com/bipolar-disorder/articles/bipolar-symptoms-in-children-mimic-other-psychiatric-disorders): Guide on differentiating bipolar disorder from ADHD and ODD in children diagnosis.

## Depression Treatment & Support

- [Warning Signs of Teen Suicide - What to Look For](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/warning-signs-of-teen-suicide-what-to-look-for): Critical guide on teen suicide warning signs and crisis intervention for parents and caregivers.
- [Mind / Body Medicine for Treating Depression](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/mind-body-medicine-for-treating-depression): Guide to psychotherapy, CBT, and mindfulness meditation techniques for depression treatment.
- [Examining Depression Among African-American Women From a Psychiatric Mental Health Nursing Perspective](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/examining-depression-among-african-american-women-from-a-psychiatric-mental-health-nursing-perspective): Article on depression disparities and misdiagnosis in African-American women from nursing perspective.
- [Food and Your Moods](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/food-and-your-moods): Article on nutrition's impact on mood and depression relief through dietary choices.
- [Helping A Depressed Person Receive Treatment For Depression](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/support/helping-a-depressed-person-receive-treatment-for-depression): Guide for families and friends on supporting depressed loved ones into treatment.
- [Personal Stories of Depression and Treatment - Laura](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/depression-treatment/personal-stories-of-depression-and-treatment-laura): First-person account of major depression diagnosis and treatment recovery journey.

## Anxiety & Panic Disorder

- [Anxiety Overlooked, Under Recognized Component of Mood Disorders in Women](https://www.healthyplace.com/anxiety-panic/articles/anxiety-overlooked-under-recognized-component-of-mood-disorders-in-women): Research on anxiety symptoms in women's mood disorders, including postpartum and menopause anxiety.
- [Helping A Family Member With An Anxiety Disorder](https://www.healthyplace.com/anxiety-panic/articles/helping-a-family-member-with-an-anxiety-disorder): Guide for families supporting loved ones with anxiety disorders and panic disorder.

## Coping Skills & Personal Development

- [Assertiveness, Non-Assertiveness, and Assertive Techniques](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/assertiveness-non-assertiveness-and-assertive-techniques): Guide on communication skills and assertiveness training for mental health and depression coping.

## Resources & References

- [Publications: Books, Videos and Audio Tapes on Depression and Manic Depression](https://www.healthyplace.com/depression/articles/publications-books-videos-and-audio-tapes-on-depression-and-manic-depression): Curated list of depression and bipolar disorder publications, including Wellness Recovery Action Plan resources.
